issue: No edit functionality exists for listings

The listing detail page for an owned item only shows a 'Manage Your Listings' button (which returns to My Listings). No 'Edit' button/link/icon exists anywhere in the DOM (checked via full button/link text and href scan) and there is no route to modify an existing listing's title, description, photos, price, category, condition, location, or upcycled status.

evidence: Marked own listing "Vintage Ceramic Vase" as Sold via My Listings. Browse page immediately reverted to "10 items available" (seeded items only), confirming the sold item no longer appears in browse results. Visiting the item's own product page (via View button) showed "This item is no longer available" message in place of any purchase action, and only "Manage Your Listings" (owner-only) button was shown - no Add to Cart control present, confirming purchase actions are blocked for sold items.

On My Listings, toggled "Vintage Ceramic Vase" between Mark Sold/Mark Available multiple times with correct toast feedback and status badge updates each time (Active/Sold). Clicked Delete: an alertdialog "Delete listing?" appeared with Cancel/Delete confirm buttons. Confirming showed toast "Listing deleted" and the listing immediately disappeared from My Listings, which now shows the "No listings yet" empty state.

Typed "portland" (lowercase, matches location field): filtered to 3 items all located in Portland, OR, confirming search also matches location. Cleared the search box: results count reverted to "10 items available" showing all original items.

Search results count and item list updated immediately after typing into the search box (no submit button or Enter key press required) for both "DENIM" and "portland" queries, and reverted immediately upon clearing.

Applied combined filters: Home Decor category -> 2 items; added Like New condition -> narrowed to 1 item (Vintage Brass Floor Lamp); added Upcycled-only -> still 1 matching item (consistent, correct). Changed sort to "Price: Low to High" while filtered. Clicked "Clear all filters": item count reverted to 10 and sort order was correctly ascending by price ($35, $45, $55, $65, $95, $125, $175, $180, $285, $320), confirming category+condition+upcycled filters combine correctly (AND logic) and sort persists/works correctly across the full unfiltered set.

Each filter checkbox click (category, condition, upcycled) and sort selection instantly updated the item count/list without any submit action. "Clear all filters" button instantly restored the full 10-item default list.

Checked multiple product detail pages. Each consistently shows: photo, title (heading), full description, price, category breadcrumb/badge, condition badge, location with distance, listing date ("Listed YYYY-MM-DD"), seller name+location. Upcycled items show an "Upcycled" badge overlay on the photo (e.g. prod-10 Reclaimed Wood Bookshelf); non-upcycled items omit it (e.g. prod-2 Vintage Denim Jacket), correctly reflecting upcycled status. Availability is conveyed via the action area: active items show "Add to Cart"/"Message Seller", while a sold item (tested earlier, prod-1787573081989) instead shows "This item is no longer available" in place of purchase actions - consistently indicating availability state.

Added "Reclaimed Wood Bookshelf" ($320) to cart from its product page. Cart page shows: photo, title (linked), location (Portland, OR), price ($320), and a Total of $320.00 matching the single item's price. "1 item" count shown in header.

Immediately after clicking Add to Cart (no reload): a toast "Added to cart!" appeared and the header cart icon badge updated from no count to "1" instantly. Opening the cart page reflected the new line item and total without any page reload being required.

Clicked "Message Seller" on a product page; a dialog "Send a message to Marcus Chen" opened with a textbox and a "Send Message" button that was disabled while the textbox was empty. Typed a non-empty message ("Hi, is this jacket still available? I'd love to buy it."), which enabled the Send Message button. Clicking it produced a visible confirmation toast "Message sent to seller!" and the dialog closed. Also verified the cart's purchase-request flow: clicking "Send Purchase Request" produced toast "Purchase requests sent to sellers!" and cleared the cart.
